notablePrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
description:
Cast Pollenbright Druid by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Pollenbright Druid spell three times.
Resolve the first Pollenbright Druid spell.
When the Pollenbright Druid token enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin.
Repeat from step 2.
